context.en: Angkor Wat makes the entry’s royal landscape visible: temple building joined political authority to religious devotion within a much wider inhabited city.
context.zh: 吴哥寺让本条所述王室景观具体可见：寺庙营建把政治权威与宗教奉献联系起来，并属于更广阔的有人居住的城市。

entryTitle.en: Angkorian courts: power across a managed landscape
entryTitle.zh: 吴哥诸宫廷：经营景观中的权力

entrySummary.en:
Angkor’s royal centers belonged to a succession of Khmer courts, not one city frozen at the height of its power. Monuments, settlements and water-management works show the organization of resources across an inhabited landscape. Different rulers sponsored different religious projects and associated royal authority with changing forms of devotion.

Building and maintaining this environment required farmers, craftspeople and labor obligations as well as kings. The movement of political centers did not mean that every earlier settlement was abandoned immediately. Angkor’s surviving monuments also represent only part of the society that supported them. A political overview connects the existing site entry to institutions and changes of authority, while avoiding an empire-wide polygon inferred solely from the distribution of temples.
entrySummary.zh:
吴哥的王室中心属于先后出现的高棉宫廷，并非一个永远停留在权力顶峰的城市。纪念建筑、聚落和水利设施，显示资源如何在有人居住的景观中被组织。不同统治者资助不同宗教工程，并把王权同变化中的信仰形式相联。

营造和维持这一环境，不仅需要国王，还依靠农民、工匠与劳役。政治中心迁移不意味着所有旧聚落立即废弃，存世纪念物也只代表支撑社会的一部分。政治概述把已有遗址条目同制度及权威变化相连，而不只根据寺院分布推定帝国全境。

reviewBasis.reviewMethod: Read saved UNESCO Angkor description and modern photograph. Exact named royal-capital landscape is central to the assembled summary; no automatic association with every Khmer ruler.

context.en: Bagan’s surviving temples give physical form to the relationship between royal authority, merit-making and many acts of patronage described here.
context.zh: 蒲甘留存的寺庙，为本条所述王权、积累功德与众多赞助行为之间的关系提供了实体景观。

entryTitle.en: Bagan: kingship and the institutions of merit
entryTitle.zh: 蒲甘：王权与功德制度

entrySummary.en:
Bagan became the center of a regional empire during the eleventh through thirteenth centuries. Royal authority and Buddhist merit-making were expressed through temples, monasteries, images and the resources assigned to religious institutions. These were working institutions sustained by people, land and skilled production rather than an isolated collection of monuments.

The surviving buildings allow comparison among different patrons and devotional forms. They do not imply that every construction was ordered by a king or that royal influence remained geographically constant. Religious activity continued as political centers and relationships changed. Linking the established Bagan place record to a political phase therefore explains institutional context while preserving the difference between the court’s period of prominence and the longer life of the sacred landscape.
entrySummary.zh:
十一至十三世纪，蒲甘成为区域帝国的中心。王权与佛教积累功德的实践，通过寺塔、僧院、造像和分配给宗教机构的资源表达。这些并非孤立纪念物的集合，而是由人口、土地与专业生产维持的运作机构。

存世建筑可以用于比较不同施主和礼拜形式，却不意味着每项营建都由国王下令，或王权影响的地理范围始终不变。政治中心和关系改变后，宗教活动仍持续。把已有蒲甘地点条目同政治阶段相连，可以解释制度背景，同时区分宫廷显赫的时期与神圣景观更长的生命。

reviewBasis.reviewMethod: Read saved UNESCO statement on Bagan’s eleventh–thirteenth-century regional capital and merit-making. The exact site and historical building landscape are the record’s subject.

context.en: Dholavira is one of the cities named in this Indus overview. Its reservoir makes the practical work of storing water visible within the wider urban network.
context.zh: 多拉维拉是本条印度河城市概览明确列举的城市之一。蓄水池让城市网络背后的储水工程具体可见。

entryTitle.en: Indus civilization · Cities and regional networks
entryTitle.zh: 印度河文明 · 城市与区域联系

entrySummary.en:
Around 2600–1900 BCE, large settlements including Mohenjo-daro and Dholavira formed part of a wider Indus or Harappan archaeological tradition. Street plans, wells, drains and craft production offer evidence of different forms of urban life. Shared material styles and connections do not prove that all cities belonged to one centrally ruled empire. Researchers continue to debate the relationships among settlements and how political authority was organized.

The surviving archaeological evidence does not provide a complete account of rulers, languages or beliefs. The map point identifies one illustrative city. It is not a reconstruction of the extent of Indus settlement, a migration route or an ethnic boundary.
entrySummary.zh:
约公元前2600—前1900年，摩亨佐达罗和多拉维拉等大型聚落属于更广泛的印度河或哈拉帕考古传统。街道、井、排水设施和手工业遗存呈现不同的城市生活；物质风格和联系相似，并不能证明所有城市都属于一个中央集权帝国。研究者仍在讨论聚落之间的关系和政治权力如何组织。

现存考古证据不能作为对统治者、语言或信仰的完整记载。地图点只标示一处示例城市，不复原聚落范围、迁徙路线或族群边界。

reviewBasis.reviewMethod: Read saved UNESCO Dholavira description of Harappan urban planning and reservoirs; the exact city is explicitly named in the entry’s account of wells and drainage.

context.en: Hampi’s stone chariot shrine belongs to the capital landscape described here, showing how Vijayanagara’s temples joined skilled production with ceremonial life.
context.zh: 亨比的石车神龛属于本条所述都城景观，呈现毗奢耶那伽罗寺庙如何结合工匠技艺与礼仪生活。

entryTitle.en: Vijayanagara: a regional empire with several successors
entryTitle.zh: 毗奢耶那伽罗：区域帝国与多个继承者

entrySummary.en:
Vijayanagara connected a large southern Indian political sphere with the capital landscape now associated with Hampi. Temples, markets and water works supported an imperial center whose prosperity depended on surrounding agriculture, circulation and service. Its rulers negotiated, fought and formed alliances with neighboring Deccan powers; religious labels alone do not explain those changing relationships.

The 1565 defeat and damage to the capital were a turning point, but not the disappearance of every successor court or political institution associated with Vijayanagara. This overview therefore separates a capital-centered imperial phase from a longer and more fragmented aftermath. Reading it beside Bahmani and successor sultanate entries helps explain a shared regional world. The representative capital does not supply a fixed boundary for every year of the interval.
entrySummary.zh:
毗奢耶那伽罗把南印度广阔的政治世界与今称亨比的都城景观相连。寺庙、市场与水利服务帝国中心，而其繁荣依赖周边农业、流通与劳动。统治者同德干邻国谈判、交战和结盟，宗教标签不足以解释这些不断变化的关系。

1565年的失败和都城受损是转折，却不代表所有继承宫廷和相关制度立即消失。本条因此区分以都城为中心的帝国阶段与更长、更分散的后续历史。与巴赫曼尼及其继承苏丹国并读，可理解共享的区域世界。代表性都城点位不能提供整个时段逐年的固定疆界。

reviewBasis.reviewMethod: Read saved UNESCO Hampi statement identifying the Vijayanagara capital and Vitthala temple stone chariot. Exact capital-site relation is substantive, not generic dynasty matching.

context.en: Nalanda was one of the Buddhist institutions supported by Pala rulers. This modern view makes that named place of teaching and patronage tangible.
context.zh: 那烂陀是波罗统治者支持的佛教机构之一。这张现代照片，使本条具名的教学与赞助场所具体可见。

entryTitle.en: Pala: Buddhist courts in Bengal and Bihar
entryTitle.zh: 波罗王朝：孟加拉与比哈尔的佛教宫廷

entrySummary.en:
Pala kings ruled in eastern South Asia while other dynasties competed for power elsewhere in the subcontinent. Their support for Buddhist institutions connected royal authority to teaching, worship and the production of images. Nalanda received patronage, and other monastic complexes formed part of this landscape.

Sculpture and manuscript traditions from eastern India circulated beyond an individual court. This makes the Pala story useful for comparing political succession with religious networks: the loss of a dynasty did not erase the institutions, artistic practices or communities associated with it.
entrySummary.zh:
波罗诸王在南亚东部统治的同时，其他王朝也在次大陆各处争夺权力。王室支持佛教机构，将政治权威与教学、礼拜和造像联系起来。那烂陀得到资助，其他寺院群也构成这一文化景观。

东印度的雕塑与写本传统并不限于单一宫廷。波罗历史因而适合用来比较政治更替与宗教网络：王朝失去统治，并不等于相关机构、艺术实践或社区随之消失。

reviewBasis.reviewMethod: The Met timeline explicitly states Pala patronage of Nalanda; saved UNESCO page and asset metadata establish this as Nalanda. No individual visible brick course or temple phase is assigned to a Pala king.

context.en: Nan Madol’s basalt walls make the Saudeleur ceremonial centre visible, connecting the entry’s account of authority with the labour of monumental construction.
context.zh: 南马都尔的玄武岩墙使绍德雷尔礼仪中心具体可见，把本条的权威叙述与大型营建所需的劳动联系起来。

entryTitle.en: Saudeleur authority: a ceremonial center on Pohnpei
entryTitle.zh: 绍德雷尔权威：波纳佩的礼仪中心

entrySummary.en:
Nan Madol’s monumental building phase offers evidence of a political order whose authority was expressed through residences, tombs and ceremony. The Saudeleur chiefs made this lagoon city a center of government and ritual. A museum synthesis describes chiefs living beside commoners and potential rivals being required to reside near the ruling center. The arrangement linked social rank to the built environment.

This political overview complements the site entry: it asks who mobilized labour and how ceremonial life helped sustain authority. Oral histories and excavated remains provide different kinds of evidence, which can be compared without treating either as an annual frontier map. The focus on buildings dated chiefly to 1200–1500 does not establish the dynasty’s exact beginning or end, or imply uniform control over every community on Pohnpei.
entrySummary.zh:
南马都尔的大型营建阶段，为一种以住宅、墓葬和仪式体现权威的政治秩序提供了证据。绍德雷尔首领以这座潟湖城市为统治与礼仪中心。博物馆研究描述了首领与平民共同居住、潜在竞争者被要求迁近统治中心的安排，社会等级由此与建筑空间相连。

本条补充遗址介绍，关注谁动员劳力，以及礼仪生活如何维系权威。口述历史与考古遗存提供不同类型的材料，可以比较，却不能直接变成逐年疆界图。约1200—1500年的建筑分期，不等于王朝确切的起讫，也不表示波纳佩所有社区始终受到同等控制。

reviewBasis.reviewMethod: Read saved UNESCO description explicitly identifying Nan Madol as the Saudeleur ceremonial centre and its basalt construction. Same exact political centre, not a general Pacific illustration.

context.en: The Great Stupa and its stone railings place Sanchi’s donor inscriptions within the sanctuary they helped support. The view shows the monument rather than a close-up of one donor’s text.
context.zh: 大塔与石栏把桑奇施主铭文放回他们支持的圣地之中。照片呈现建筑整体，并非某位施主铭文的特写。

entryTitle.en: Names on the stone: the donors of Sanchi
entryTitle.zh: 刻在石上的姓名：桑奇的施主

entrySummary.en:
Dhamarakhitā of Madhuvana appears at Sanchi through a brief record of a gift. Other inscriptions name monks, nuns and lay donors, sometimes adding a home town, occupation or teacher. Their short texts turn stone railings and monuments into traces of many participants. A sanctuary associated with royal patronage was also sustained by people whose names rarely enter dynastic histories.

Studies of the first-century BCE inscriptions draw particular attention to women’s contributions. Giving allowed donors to participate in a religious community and leave a durable acknowledgement of that participation. The records do not provide complete household budgets or explain every donor’s motives. Their strength is more concrete: they preserve named acts of support. Read them beside the monuments and the scale of the work changes, from the ambition of a ruler to the accumulated gifts of a wider community.
entrySummary.zh:
来自Madhuvana的女性施主Dhamarakhitā，以一则简短的捐献记录出现在桑奇。其他铭文记有僧人、比丘尼与在家施主，有时还注明家乡、职业或师承。石栏和建筑上的短句，因此保存了许多参与者的痕迹。一处与王室赞助相连的圣地，也由那些很少进入王朝史的人共同支持。

研究公元前一世纪铭文的学者尤其注意到女性的贡献。捐献让施主参与宗教社群，并留下持久的记载。这些文字没有完整的家庭收支，也未解释每位施主的动机；它们能够具体证明的，是一次次有名可考的支持行为。把铭文与建筑并读，工程的历史便从君主的事业扩展到众多成员逐步积累的赠予。

reviewBasis.reviewMethod: Read exact donor story and saved UNESCO Sanchi description of railings, gateways and inscriptions. Admitted as the named sanctuary’s setting, not as a legible image of Dhamarakhitā’s inscription.

context.en: Mohenjo-daro is another city named in this overview. Its Great Bath offers a concrete comparison with Dholavira’s reservoir: two different uses of water in Indus urban life.
context.zh: 摩亨佐达罗是本条列举的另一座城市。大浴池可与多拉维拉蓄水池具体对读，展示印度河城市生活中两种不同的用水设施。

entryTitle.en: Indus civilization · Cities and regional networks
entryTitle.zh: 印度河文明 · 城市与区域联系

entrySummary.en:
Around 2600–1900 BCE, large settlements including Mohenjo-daro and Dholavira formed part of a wider Indus or Harappan archaeological tradition. Street plans, wells, drains and craft production offer evidence of different forms of urban life. Shared material styles and connections do not prove that all cities belonged to one centrally ruled empire. Researchers continue to debate the relationships among settlements and how political authority was organized.

The surviving archaeological evidence does not provide a complete account of rulers, languages or beliefs. The map point identifies one illustrative city. It is not a reconstruction of the extent of Indus settlement, a migration route or an ethnic boundary.
entrySummary.zh:
约公元前2600—前1900年，摩亨佐达罗和多拉维拉等大型聚落属于更广泛的印度河或哈拉帕考古传统。街道、井、排水设施和手工业遗存呈现不同的城市生活；物质风格和联系相似，并不能证明所有城市都属于一个中央集权帝国。研究者仍在讨论聚落之间的关系和政治权力如何组织。

现存考古证据不能作为对统治者、语言或信仰的完整记载。地图点只标示一处示例城市，不复原聚落范围、迁徙路线或族群边界。

reviewBasis.reviewMethod: Read saved UNESCO description of Moenjodaro and admitted photograph of the Great Bath. The exact city is central to the overview; a second association adds no additional covered ID.

context.en: Compare the scale of standing and fallen stones to consider quarrying, transport and collective labour.
context.zh: 比较直立与倒卧石材的尺度，思考开采、运输和集体劳动。

context.en: The long approach and ordered towers make royal religious architecture visible; the full city extended beyond this view.
context.zh: 长轴线与有序塔群呈现王室宗教建筑的组织方式；城市的范围远超这一视野。

context.en: A landscape view reveals many acts of patronage rather than one isolated monument.
context.zh: 景观视角让人看到多次供养营建的累积，而非一座孤立古迹。

context.en: The repeated stupas help explain an architectural sequence experienced by walking, not just viewing from outside.
context.zh: 反复排列的佛塔展示了通过行走体验的建筑序列，而不只是外部轮廓。

context.en: The exposed walls bring archaeology into the urban story: knowledge of early buildings depends on excavation and preservation as well as monumental outlines.
context.zh: 露出的墙体使考古工作进入城市史：对早期建筑的认识不仅依赖宏伟轮廓，也依赖发掘与保护。

context.en: Read the basin as urban infrastructure: storing seasonal water helped sustain a city in an arid setting.
context.zh: 将水池视为城市基础设施：储存季节性水源有助于干旱环境中的城市生活。

context.en: The view helps readers distinguish the great enclosure from a wider settlement landscape built by African communities.
context.zh: 这一视角帮助读者区分大围墙与非洲社群营建的更广阔聚落景观。

context.en: Its wheels translate a processional vehicle into permanent stone architecture, linking craft and ceremonial space.
context.zh: 石轮将仪式车辆转化为永久石建筑，把工艺与礼仪空间连接起来。

context.en: Mosque architecture brings religious institutions into the story of a trading city, alongside its ships and commodities.
context.zh: 清真寺建筑使宗教机构进入贸易城市的历史，与船舶和货物共同构成城市生活。

context.en: The surrounding trench reveals the construction method: builders removed stone to leave architecture standing.
context.zh: 周围深沟揭示施工方法：建造者移除岩石，让建筑留在原地。

context.en: Their steep profiles and adjoining chapels invite comparison with other Nile monuments while keeping Kush’s own royal tradition in view.
context.zh: 陡峭轮廓与相邻礼拜堂既可与尼罗河其他古迹比较，也呈现库施自身的王室传统。

context.en: Brick-lined water architecture makes the entry’s account of organized urban life concrete, without requiring a named king.
context.zh: 砖砌水利建筑让条目中的城市组织具体可见，无须假定某位已知国王。

context.en: The surviving walls turn a history of learning into a question of space: study, residence and worship needed connected buildings.
context.zh: 遗存墙体使学习史成为空间问题：研习、居住和礼拜需要相互连接的建筑。

context.en: Stacked columns show how distinctive local materials supported large-scale island engineering.
context.zh: 叠置石柱展示独特地方材料如何支撑大规模岛屿工程。

context.en: Look at the relationship between gate, path and dome: Buddhist worship shaped both architecture and movement.
context.zh: 观察门、路径与圆顶的关系：佛教礼拜同时塑造了建筑和行进方式。

context.en: Read the gardens together with the summit: engineering below helped give meaning to royal height above.
context.zh: 将园林与岩顶合看：下方工程与上方王室高地共同构成景观。

context.en: The view makes alignment and repeated building forms legible at the scale of a city.
context.zh: 这一视角使城市尺度的轴线与重复建筑形式清晰可读。

context.en: The tower’s scale opens a discussion of the builders, endowments and institutional resources behind a royal religious commission.
context.zh: 塔体尺度引出对建造者、捐赠与机构资源的讨论，展现王室宗教工程背后的组织。

context.en: The temple is an anchor for reading the city, not a substitute for its many households and living Maya history.
context.zh: 神庙是理解城市的定位点，不能代替众多住户与延续至今的玛雅历史。

context.en: Joan’s later image became part of how the Hundred Years War was remembered in France.
context.zh: 贞德的后世形象，成为法国记忆百年战争的一部分。

context.en: Joan’s later image became part of how the Hundred Years War was remembered in France.
context.zh: 贞德的后世形象，成为法国记忆百年战争的一部分。

context.en: Caracalla issued the citizenship measure examined here; this is an official image from his reign.
context.zh: 卡拉卡拉发布了本条讨论的公民权敕令；此像为他在位时的官方形象。

context.en: A ration account from Umma shows Ur III administration at the level of daily supplies.
context.zh: 温马的口粮账目，从日常物资层面展示乌尔第三王朝行政。

context.en: This is Ilabrat-bani’s letter about textiles and travel, discussed in the Kanesh household story.
context.zh: 这正是卡内什家庭故事中伊拉布拉特巴尼谈及织品与旅行的书信。

context.en: This Bukhara cover is the surviving textile used to explore collaborative embroidery.
context.zh: 这件布哈拉盖布，是探究协作刺绣的传世实物。

context.en: The painted cotton preserves the skilled production behind Coromandel’s export trade.
context.zh: 彩绘棉布保存了科罗曼德尔出口贸易背后的专业制作痕迹。

context.en: The painted cotton preserves the skilled production behind Coromandel’s export trade.
context.zh: 彩绘棉布保存了科罗曼德尔出口贸易背后的专业制作痕迹。

context.en: Merian’s own artwork links botanical observation to her Amsterdam workshop.
context.zh: 梅里安本人的画作，把植物观察与她的阿姆斯特丹作坊相连。

context.en: This lifetime portrait circulated in Galileo’s scientific books after his early telescopic observations.
context.zh: 伽利略早期望远镜观测之后，这幅生前肖像随他的科学著作流传。

context.en: Bookbinding was one of the practical crafts made visible in the Encyclopédie’s plates.
context.zh: 装订是《百科全书》图版所呈现的实用技艺之一。

context.en: Cranach’s 1521 engraving presents Luther during the early spread of Reformation debate.
context.zh: 克拉纳赫1521年的版画，表现宗教改革论辩传播初期的路德。

context.en: Local enamel work made Byzantine Christian imagery wearable in Kyivan Rus’.
context.zh: 本地珐琅工艺使拜占庭基督教图像成为基辅罗斯可佩戴的饰物。

context.en: A Kerma beaker excavated in Egypt supplies material evidence of contact across the Nile valley.
context.zh: 在埃及出土的克尔马陶杯，为尼罗河流域间的接触提供实物证据。

context.en: The 1580 folio documents the afterlife of Navoi’s poetry in illustrated books.
context.zh: 1580年的书页记录纳沃伊诗歌在绘本中的后世流传。

context.en: Chimú ceremonial feasting depended on objects made by highly specialised metalworkers.
context.zh: 奇穆仪式宴饮使用的器物，依靠高度专业化的金属工匠制作。

context.en: A miniature bronze anchors the wider history of Đông Sơn drums and regional connections.
context.zh: 小型铜鼓为东山文化铜鼓及区域联系的历史提供实物起点。

context.en: This is the thirteenth-century Prajnaparamita figure cited in the Sukhothai arts entry.
context.zh: 这正是素可泰艺术条目引用的十三世纪般若波罗蜜多像。

context.en: Pagan-period image-making continued across changes in Bagan’s political authority.
context.zh: 蒲甘时期的造像传统，跨越蒲甘政治权力的变化而延续。

context.en: The border fragment preserves Paracas embroiderers’ choices of pattern, colour and repeated form.
context.zh: 边饰残片保存帕拉卡斯绣工对纹样、颜色与重复形式的选择。

context.en: This is the ninth–eleventh-century funerary mask that anchors the Sicán craft story.
context.zh: 这正是西坎工艺故事以之为依据的九至十一世纪葬仪面具。

context.en: The Batavian Revolution of 1795 marks the political transition at the end of this Dutch Republic overview.
context.zh: 1795年巴达维亚革命，对应荷兰共和国概述终点的政治转型。

context.en: A drawing made in 1812 records the royal imagery of a much earlier Sasanian monument.
context.zh: 1812年的画作，记录年代远为久远的萨珊纪念物上的王权图像。

context.en: The palace guardian makes Neo-Assyrian monumental kingship visible at human approach scale.
context.zh: 宫殿守护神，使新亚述纪念性王权在人们走近建筑时具体可感。

context.en: The grain account connects early writing with the storage and distribution systems of urban life.
context.zh: 谷物账目，把早期书写与城市生活中的存储和分配制度相连。

context.en: The dated tile links Ilkhanid ceramic production with Shi‘i devotion under Uljaitu.
context.zh: 有纪年的瓷砖，把伊儿汗国陶瓷制作与完者都时期的什叶派信仰相连。

context.en: Shared ceramic designs offer a material view of connections among Samanid urban centres.
context.zh: 共享陶器纹样，从实物层面展示萨曼城市中心间的联系。

context.en: Pala-period Buddhist image-making forms part of the religious networks of eastern India.
context.zh: 波罗时期的佛教造像，是东印度宗教网络的一部分。

context.en: Dasoja’s signed sculpture identifies a maker within Hoysala temple culture.
context.zh: 达索贾署名的雕像，指出曷萨拉寺庙文化中的一位具体制作者。

context.en: A Qajar ruler’s calligraphy offers another medium of royal artistic self-presentation.
context.zh: 卡扎尔君王的书法，提供王室艺术自我展示的另一种媒介。

context.en: Its stepped profile makes one stage in the development of royal stone tombs visible.
context.zh: 阶梯轮廓呈现王室石墓发展中的一个阶段。

context.en: Thick earth walls and projecting timbers make the building’s materials visible; its survival depends on repeated maintenance.
context.zh: 厚土墙与外伸木梁让建筑材料清晰可见；建筑的延续依靠反复维护。

context.en: Compare the raised summit with the lower ground: topography helped organize social separation.
context.zh: 将高处山顶与低地比较：地形参与了社会空间的分隔。

context.en: The repeated rooms shift attention from royal tombs to the households that built them.
context.zh: 重复排列的房间将视线从王陵转向建造王陵的家庭。

context.en: Connected rooms and passages place households beside trade in the history of the Swahili coast.
context.zh: 相连的房间和通道将家庭生活与贸易并列为斯瓦希里海岸的历史内容。

context.en: The wall supports and decorates an elevated living platform: masonry organized status as well as space.
context.zh: 墙体支撑并装饰抬高的居住平台，砌石既组织空间，也表达身份。

context.en: Street width and closely joined houses reveal the neighbourhood scale of a Swahili port.
context.zh: 街巷尺度与毗连住宅呈现斯瓦希里港城的邻里生活。

context.en: Read figures and platform together as a ceremonial arrangement, while recognizing the restored presentation.
context.zh: 将石像与平台视作整体仪式布局，同时注意今天的陈列经过修复。

context.en: Follow the curved walls to see how flowing water and fish movement shaped the design.
context.zh: 沿弧形石墙观察水流和鱼类活动如何影响设计。

context.en: The level plaza and elevated platforms reveal labour spent on reshaping ground as well as raising buildings.
context.zh: 平整广场与高台展现整治地面和营建建筑所需的共同劳动。

context.en: The stair leads the eye upward while the burial lies below, linking public monument and hidden tomb.
context.zh: 阶梯引导视线上升，墓葬却位于下方，将公共纪念建筑与隐蔽陵墓联系起来。

context.en: Compare open space and narrow access points to explore how architecture organized different experiences.
context.zh: 比较开放空间与狭窄入口，理解建筑如何组织不同体验。

context.en: Circular building outlines bring residential life into a site often introduced only through its great outer wall.
context.zh: 圆形建筑轮廓使居住生活进入视野，而这处遗址常只以巨大外墙为人所知。

context.en: Repeated tiers and the steep approach make ordered ascent part of the monument’s effect.
context.zh: 重复层台与陡峭阶梯使有序上升成为建筑体验的一部分。

context.en: The water axis, paired elements and central dome organize remembrance through a carefully planned approach.
context.zh: 水渠轴线、对称构件与中央穹顶通过精心规划的路径表达纪念。

context.en: Repeated walls and adjoining plots make the city’s organization visible at the scale of buildings and rooms.
context.zh: 重复墙体与相邻地块使城市组织在建筑和房间尺度上可见。

context.en: Pillars and the curving aisle shape movement around a sacred focus cut from the rock itself.
context.zh: 柱列与弧形通道组织绕行，神圣焦点也由岩体本身凿成。

context.en: Threshold, stair, guardians and Buddha turn an entrance into a sequence of carved encounters.
context.zh: 门阶、阶梯、守护者与佛像，使入口成为连续的雕刻体验。

context.en: Open columns and diminishing terraces offer a contrast to the enclosed rooms of other court buildings.
context.zh: 开敞柱列与逐级退台，可与其他宫廷建筑的封闭房间对照。

context.en: The stupa marks Buddhist patronage within a wider city of walls, moats and cultivated land.
context.zh: 佛塔显示佛教供养的规模，周边城市还包括城墙、护城河与耕地。

context.en: The carved figures accompany the descent toward water, joining practical access with a sacred architectural setting.
context.zh: 雕刻人物伴随通向水面的下降路径，将实用取水与神圣建筑环境结合。

context.en: Bridge, water and houses show how movement and inhabited streets worked together in the port.
context.zh: 桥、水道与住宅共同呈现港城交通与日常街巷的联系。

context.en: Compare the vessels’ size and spacing; dates established at one sampled site do not automatically date every visible jar.
context.zh: 比较石缸尺寸与间距；某一采样遗址的测年不能自动适用于所有可见石缸。

context.en: The pillar is evidence of Mauryan-era commemoration; it does not supply a contemporary birth record of the Buddha.
context.zh: 石柱见证孔雀王朝时期的纪念活动，并非佛陀诞生当时的记录。

context.en: Curved surfaces and monumental scale turn astronomical relationships into architecture; the whole instrument extends beyond this close view.
context.zh: 弧面与巨大尺度把天文关系转化为建筑；完整仪器超出这一近景。

context.en: Follow water and retaining walls across the slope: this landscape depends on continuing community work.
context.zh: 沿坡面观察水流与挡墙：这片景观依靠社群持续维护。

context.en: Compare upright markers and horizontal courses while recognizing that excavated monuments have also been restored.
context.zh: 比较直立石与水平石层，同时注意发掘后的古迹也经过修复。

context.en: The whole horizon matters: a sequence of towers can mark a calendar, rather than a single solstice.
context.zh: 整个地平线都很重要：连续塔列能标记年历，而非只指示一次至日。

context.en: The junction between masonry traditions makes the city’s layered history visible.
context.zh: 不同砌筑传统的交界让城市的多层历史可见。

context.en: Small rooms and earthen construction put domestic life at the centre of the archaeological story.
context.zh: 小房间与土质建筑使家庭生活成为考古叙事的中心。

context.en: The close view reveals the wall as accumulated masonry and maintenance, not simply a line around a city.
context.zh: 近景显示城墙是砌筑和维护的累积，不只是围绕城市的一条线。
